# What will this container's dwell time cost?

> Free calculator for importers and forwarders: what will demurrage and detention cost on your containers? Enter your dates, free days and tiered per-day rates to see the bill, the last free day, what one more day costs and what an earlier pickup is worth. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
